preconditions.description: The number of jewelry pieces, n, must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The number of colors, k, must be a positive integer.
The number of colors specified must match the number of jewelry pieces.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= k for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Each color must be between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(colors[i] != colors[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if is_prime_divisor(i+2, j+2))
postconditions.description: Two pieces of jewelry with prices that have a prime divisor relationship must have different colors.
